primaryResearch.supports: Artist confirms1975 original eleven-track Between the Lines programme.
Paul Marcano’s own site confirms original1981 seven-track Lightdreams album and original limited vinyl issue.
Artist estate identifies Axis, RepriseRS6281, first UK1967 and American1968 release. Physical6307 belongs Electric Ladyland, not Axis.
Contemporary Capitol advertisement reproduces the exact Edward Kasper storefront painting and identifies The Band / Moondog Matinee / SW11214.

limitations: New original photographs prove the visible faces and catalogues, but a front/back pair alone does not determine matrix/runout or every pressing variant.
Merged source slots must remain traceable to frozen guide IDs; do not renumber later stable IDs.
